'''Jamona''' was the name of a location in the [[Juran Mountains/Legends|Juran Mountains]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] that was in ruins by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. The ruins were located in a cave along the [[Fornaak River]], just east of the waterfall that took the river into the [[Glarus Valley]].
